title: ADF parameters, variables and expressions
summary: Use parameters for external inputs and variables for mutable orchestration state.

blocks.text: Use parameters for external inputs and variables for mutable orchestration state.

items: Pipeline parameters are inputs and should be treated as immutable for the run.
Variables can change during a run but can make parallel loops unsafe if shared.
Dataset and linked-service parameters make reusable templates.
Keep expressions simple enough to debug; move complex business transformations to an appropriate compute engine.

provenance: Original AtlasNote V3 foundation seed authored for product integration; no third-party text or private data.
